description: This file contains extension methods for database operations, including parameter creation, data retrieval from IDataRecord and DbDataReader objects, reflection-based parameterization, and record-to-object mapping. It is specifically designed to facilitate database interactions within the Orleans AdoNet storage implementations.

classes.name: DbExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for database parameter creation, data retrieval, reflection-based parameter setting, and mapping IDataRecord to objects.

methods.name: CreateParameter
methods.description: Creates a new IDbDataParameter with specified name, value, direction, size, and type.

methods.name: AddParameter
methods.description: Adds a new parameter to an IDbCommand with specified name, value, direction, size, and type.

methods.name: GetValueOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a value from IDataRecord or DbDataReader; returns default if null or DBNull.

methods.name: GetDateTimeValueOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime? value from IDataRecord; sets kind to UTC, or returns default if null.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a strongly typed value from IDataRecord by field name.

methods.name: GetDateTimeValue
methods.description: Retrieves a DateTime value from IDataRecord by field name, setting kind to UTC.

methods.name: GetInt32
methods.description: Retrieves an int value from IDataRecord by field name.

methods.name: GetInt64
methods.description: Retrieves a long value from IDataRecord, handling potential schema differences.

methods.name: GetNullableInt32
methods.description: Retrieves a nullable int from IDataRecord, returning null if DBNull.

methods.name: GetValueAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a value from DbDataReader by field name.

methods.name: ReflectionParameterProvider
methods.description: Uses reflection to add parameters to an IDbCommand based on properties of a given object.

methods.name: ReflectionSelector
methods.description: Constructs an object of specified type from IDataRecord via reflection, mapping record fields to properties.
